why: [R-ASSET-01] with the ratchet of [R-ENF-02]. Every study in scope on the day the rule was adopted (07-09-2026) predates it and commits no asset_base_record; each is allowed to fail while it waits its turn in the rebuild queue. Entries carry the MEASUREMENT where one was taken, so the debt is countable rather than remembered. The build breaks on a NEW in-scope study with no entry either way, on a listed study whose record has appeared and is wrong, or on a committed class that resolves to nothing. This list may only ever get SHORTER (--prune). [R-ENF-08, 07-09-2026]: each entry now carries the SIGNATURE of the failure it excuses. A ratchet entry is a ticker, so before this a listed study was excused from the whole gate and could acquire a SECOND, DIFFERENT defect of the same class unseen — which the injection harness demonstrated by planting a stale land base in a study already listed and being ignored. Comparison is on the failure's SHAPE with live figures stripped, because an exact-text match would go red every time a date moved.
